accession.en: officially joining a group like the EU
accession.ex: Croatia's accession to the EU took several years.

accord.ex: Both sides signed a trade accord last spring.

achieve.en: to succeed in getting a result
achieve.ex: She worked hard to achieve her goals.

adamant.en: very sure and refusing to change
adamant.ex: He was adamant that he had done nothing wrong.

added.ex: She added that the shop would open on Sunday.

aerial.ex: The aerial photos showed the flooded fields.

agreement.en: a deal between two or more sides
agreement.ex: The two companies reached an agreement on prices.

also.ex: She speaks French and also some German.

amassed.ex: She amassed a large collection of old coins.

announcement.ex: The school made an announcement about the trip.

answers.ex: We still have no answers about the delay.

anticipated.ex: The company anticipated strong sales at Christmas.

are.ex: The shops are open until eight.

arrangement.en: a plan or deal agreed by people
arrangement.ex: We have an arrangement to share the car.

asked.ex: He asked for more time to finish.

asserted.ex: The minister asserted that the plan would work.

at.en: in a particular place or time

attending.ex: She is attending a conference in Cork.

attention.ex: Attention will now move to the final vote.

back.en: to the place or state before
back.ex: Please bring the book back on Monday.

be.ex: The shop will be closed tomorrow.

become.ex: The new road will become busy quickly.

big.ex: They live in a big house near the sea.

bilateral.ex: The two ministers held bilateral talks in Paris.

example.en: The two countries signed a bilateral trade agreement.
example.zh: 兩國簽署了一項雙邊貿易協定。

note.meaning: 雙邊的；涉及兩方（通常是兩國）的。
note.usage: 常見 bilateral meeting/talks/agreement；多方則用 multilateral。

noteEn.meaning: between two groups or two countries.

noteEs.exampleTr: Los dos países firmaron un acuerdo comercial bilateral.
noteEs.meaning: bilateral; entre dos partes o países.
noteEs.usage: Frecuente: bilateral talks/agreement; con muchos países: multilateral.

noteHi.exampleTr: दोनों देशों ने एक द्विपक्षीय व्यापार समझौते पर हस्ताक्षर किए।
noteHi.usage: bilateral talks/agreement आम हैं; कई पक्षों के लिए multilateral।

noteJa.exampleTr: 両国は二国間貿易協定に署名した。
noteJa.usage: bilateral talks/agreement の形が多い。多国間は multilateral。

noteKo.exampleTr: 두 나라는 양자 무역 협정에 서명했다.
noteKo.usage: bilateral talks/agreement 형태가 흔하며 다자간은 multilateral.

bolster.ex: Good results bolster the team's confidence.

borders.ex: The two countries share long borders.

brief.ex: The coach will brief the players before the game.

build.ex: They plan to build a new school.

built.ex: She has built up a lot of experience.

called.ex: Parents called for safer roads near the school.

came.ex: Many tourists came to the festival.

capacity.en: an official role (in its capacity as)
capacity.ex: She spoke in her capacity as chairperson.

capital.en: the main city of a country
capital.ex: Dublin is the capital of Ireland.

ceding.en: giving land or power to another
ceding.ex: The club refused to consider ceding control.

chance.ex: There is a chance of rain tomorrow.

chapters.ex: The book has twelve short chapters.

choose.ex: You can choose any seat you like.

closer.ex: Move your chair closer to the table.

clusters.en: groups of topics in EU talks
clusters.ex: The negotiations are divided into six clusters.

co-production.ex: The film is a co-production between two countries.

commitments.ex: The firm made commitments to cut waste.

committed.en: promised that someone will do something
committed.ex: The mayor committed the city to cleaner air.

community.en: a group of countries working together
community.ex: The local community raised money for the park.

complete.ex: You must complete the form by Friday.

concrete.ex: We need concrete plans, not ideas.

conflict.ex: The conflict forced many families to leave.

consequence.en: a result (as a consequence of = because of)
consequence.ex: Higher prices were a consequence of the storm.
consequence.zh: 結果（as a consequence of：由於）

considerable.ex: The project took a considerable amount of time.

contended.ex: Critics contended that the plan was too costly.

convened.en: called people together for a meeting
convened.ex: The mayor convened a meeting of local groups.

cooperation.en: working together for a shared goal
cooperation.ex: The project needs cooperation between two cities.

could.ex: She could see the sea from her room.

council.en: an official group that makes decisions
council.ex: The city council voted on the new park.
council.zh: 理事會（Council of the EU：歐盟理事會）

counterpart.en: person or office with the same job elsewhere
counterpart.ex: The minister met her French counterpart in Paris.

example.en: The Irish minister met her French counterpart in Paris.
example.zh: 愛爾蘭部長在巴黎與法國的對口部長會面。

note.meaning: 對應的人或機構；職位相當的對方。
note.usage: 常用 one's counterpart（對方同級者），如 the minister met his French counterpart。

noteEn.meaning: a person or group with the same job on the other side.

noteEs.exampleTr: La ministra irlandesa se reunió con su homóloga francesa en París.
noteEs.meaning: homólogo; persona o institución con el mismo cargo en otro lado.

noteHi.exampleTr: आयरिश मंत्री ने पेरिस में अपनी फ्रांसीसी समकक्ष से मुलाकात की।
noteHi.meaning: समकक्ष; दूसरे पक्ष में समान पद वाला व्यक्ति या संस्था।

noteJa.exampleTr: アイルランドの大臣はパリでフランスの大臣と会談した。
noteJa.meaning: 相手方の同等の人・機関；カウンターパート。
noteJa.usage: one's counterpart（相手側の同等の地位の人）の形で使う。

noteKo.exampleTr: 아일랜드 장관은 파리에서 프랑스 측 장관을 만났다.
noteKo.meaning: 상대역; 다른 쪽에서 같은 지위의 사람이나 기관.

country.en: a nation with its own government
country.ex: Her country has a long coastline.

course.en: in due course: at the right time later
course.ex: You will hear from us in due course.
course.zh: 過程（in due course：在適當時候）

covering.ex: The report covers health and education.

deal.ex: The two shops made a deal on prices.

declared.ex: The mayor declared the bridge open.

defence.en: protecting a country with military forces
defence.ex: The country spends more on defence each year.

department.ex: She works for the Department of Health.

deployment.en: putting something into use for a task
deployment.ex: The deployment of new software took a week.

example.en: The deployment of new software took three weeks.
example.zh: 新軟體的部署花了三週。

note.meaning: 部署；（技術、資源或部隊的）調度與投入使用。
note.usage: 可指軍隊部署，也可指技術的導入，如 deployment of technology。

noteEn.meaning: putting something into use or into position.

noteEs.exampleTr: El despliegue del nuevo software tardó tres semanas.
noteEs.meaning: despliegue; puesta en uso de recursos o tecnología.

noteHi.exampleTr: नए सॉफ़्टवेयर की तैनाती में तीन सप्ताह लगे।
noteHi.meaning: तैनाती; किसी तकनीक या संसाधन का उपयोग में लाना।
noteHi.usage: deployment of + संज्ञा; सेना या तकनीक दोनों के लिए।

noteJa.exampleTr: 新しいソフトウェアの導入には3週間かかった。
noteJa.usage: deployment of + 名詞 の形。軍隊にも技術にも使う。

noteKo.usage: deployment of + 명사 형태로 군대와 기술 모두에 쓴다.

developed.ex: She developed strong skills at work.

did.ex: He did his homework before dinner.

disclosed.ex: The firm disclosed its profits on Monday.

discussions.ex: Discussions about the new park continue.

do.ex: I will do everything I can.

does.ex: She does not like cold weather.

donbas.zh: 頓巴斯（烏克蘭東部地區）

done.ex: Have you done your homework yet?

drone.en: an aircraft with no pilot on board
drone.ex: A drone filmed the concert from above.

drones.en: aircraft with no pilot on board
drones.ex: Farmers use drones to check their fields.

due.ex: The train is due at six o'clock.

emphasised.en: said firmly that something is important
emphasised.ex: The teacher emphasised the need for practice.

end.en: the last part of a period
end.ex: We moved house at the end of May.

engage.ex: Students engage in group projects each week.

engaged.ex: The two sides are engaged in peace talks.
engaged.zh: 從事於（be engaged in：正在進行）

enhance.en: to make something better or stronger
enhance.ex: Good lighting can enhance a small room.

envisage.en: to imagine or plan as likely
envisage.ex: We do not envisage any delays.

example.en: The council envisages building 500 new homes.
example.zh: 議會預計興建五百戶新住宅。

note.usage: 英式拼法，美式為 envision；後接名詞或 V-ing，如 envisage returning them。

noteEn.meaning: to expect or imagine something will happen.
noteEn.usage: Follow with a noun or -ing form.

noteEs.exampleTr: El ayuntamiento prevé construir 500 viviendas nuevas.
noteEs.usage: Ortografía británica; va seguido de sustantivo o -ing.

noteHi.exampleTr: परिषद 500 नए घर बनाने की योजना सोचती है।
noteHi.meaning: कल्पना करना; किसी बात के होने की अपेक्षा करना।
noteHi.usage: ब्रिटिश वर्तनी; इसके बाद संज्ञा या V-ing आता है।

noteJa.exampleTr: 議会は500戸の新築住宅の建設を想定している。
noteJa.usage: イギリス英語の綴り。名詞や動名詞を目的語にとる。

noteKo.exampleTr: 의회는 새 주택 500채 건설을 구상하고 있다.
noteKo.usage: 영국식 철자이며 명사나 동명사를 목적어로 취한다.

envoys.en: official representatives sent by a government
envoys.ex: The envoys arrived for talks in Geneva.

evaluating.en: carefully judging the value of something
evaluating.ex: The council is evaluating three new designs.

examining.ex: Police are examining the CCTV footage.

exists.ex: A strong link exists between sleep and health.

expected.ex: We expected the bus to be late.

expects.ex: She expects good news this week.

expertise.ex: Her expertise in law helped the team.

example.en: She has great expertise in data analysis.
example.zh: 她在資料分析方面有深厚的專業知識。

note.usage: 不可數名詞；常用 expertise in/on + 領域，如 expertise in drones。

noteEn.meaning: special skill or knowledge in an area.

noteEs.exampleTr: Ella tiene una gran pericia en análisis de datos.

noteHi.exampleTr: उसके पास डेटा विश्लेषण में गहरी विशेषज्ञता है।

noteJa.exampleTr: 彼女はデータ分析に関して深い専門知識を持っている。
noteJa.usage: 不可算名詞。expertise in + 分野 の形で使う。

noteKo.exampleTr: 그녀는 데이터 분석에 깊은 전문 지식을 갖고 있다.
noteKo.usage: 불가산 명사로 expertise in + 분야 형태로 쓴다.

exploring.en: looking into something to learn more
exploring.ex: The school is exploring new teaching methods.

facilitating.ex: The charity is facilitating talks between the groups.

example.en: Good transport links facilitate trade between regions.
example.zh: 便利的交通連結促進了地區之間的貿易。

note.meaning: 促進；使（某事）更容易進行。
note.usage: 及物動詞，後接名詞或動名詞；名詞為 facilitation，常見於正式與學術寫作。

noteEn.meaning: to make something easier to do or happen.
noteEn.usage: Formal word. Use it with a noun: 'facilitate the process'.

noteEs.exampleTr: Las buenas conexiones de transporte facilitan el comercio entre regiones.
noteEs.usage: Verbo formal y transitivo; va seguido de un sustantivo.

noteHi.exampleTr: अच्छे परिवहन संपर्क क्षेत्रों के बीच व्यापार को सुगम बनाते हैं।
noteHi.usage: औपचारिक लेखन में आम; इसके बाद संज्ञा आती है।

noteJa.exampleTr: 良い交通網は地域間の貿易を促進する。
noteJa.usage: 他動詞で、名詞や動名詞を目的語にとる。改まった文体で多い。

noteKo.exampleTr: 좋은 교통망은 지역 간 무역을 촉진한다.
noteKo.usage: 타동사로 명사나 동명사를 목적어로 취하며 격식체에서 흔하다.

for.en: used to show purpose or time

formidable.ex: She has a formidable memory for names.

from.en: showing where something starts or comes

fulfilled.ex: He fulfilled his promise to help.

full-scale.ex: The city began a full-scale clean-up.

further.ex: He further explained the new rules.

future.ex: Young people care about the future of the planet.

gather.en: to come together in one place
gather.ex: Fans gather outside the stadium early.

gathering.ex: The family gathering was held in Galway.

give.ex: Herbs give the soup a fresh taste.

harnessing.en: using something to get its benefits
harnessing.ex: We should be harnessing wind power more.

has.en: owns; also used to form past tenses

have.en: own; also used to form past tenses
have.ex: We have enough time to finish.

headway.ex: The talks made little headway this week.

hold.ex: The club will hold a party next week.

holder.en: a person or country that has a position
holder.ex: The holder of the title will defend it.

holds.ex: She holds a degree in law.

home.en: to the place where someone lives

hosting.en: organising an event as the host
hosting.ex: The city is hosting the games next summer.

however.ex: It was cold; however, we still swam.

impossible.ex: It is impossible to finish this in an hour.

in.en: inside; at a place or time

indicated.ex: The report indicated a rise in prices.

informal.ex: We had an informal chat after work.

insisted.en: said firmly that something is true
insisted.ex: She insisted that she was right.

integrity.ex: The bridge's structural integrity was tested.

intention.ex: I have no intention of moving.

invasion.en: an army entering another country by force
invasion.ex: The invasion forced many families to flee.

joining.ex: She is thinking about joining a gym.

joint.ex: The two firms made a joint statement.

know-how.ex: The company lacks the technical know-how.

knows.ex: He knows a lot about cars.

kushner.en: surname of US envoy Jared Kushner

leader.en: a person in charge of a country
leader.ex: The leader gave a speech to the nation.

leaders.ex: World leaders met to discuss climate change.

learned.ex: I learned to swim when I was six.

leave.en: let something stay as it is
leave.zh: 留下（leave no stone unturned：竭盡全力）

looking.ex: We are looking at new ways to save money.

lot.ex: She knows a lot about music.

made.ex: The mayor made a speech yesterday.

maintained.en: said firmly that something is true
maintained.ex: He maintained that he had done nothing wrong.

make.ex: They make furniture in that factory.
make.zh: 製造；取得（make progress / make a profit）

making.ex: He is good at making cakes.

manufacturing.ex: Manufacturing jobs are important for the region.

maritime.ex: The navy protects maritime trade routes.

example.en: The navy patrols the country's maritime border every day.
example.zh: 海軍每天巡邏該國的海上邊界。

note.meaning: 海上的；與海洋或航運有關的。
note.usage: 多作形容詞置於名詞前，如 maritime security（海上安全）、maritime law。

noteEn.meaning: connected with the sea or ships.
noteEn.usage: Used before a noun, e.g. 'maritime security'.

noteEs.exampleTr: La armada patrulla cada día la frontera marítima del país.
noteEs.meaning: marítimo; relacionado con el mar o la navegación.
noteEs.usage: Adjetivo antes del sustantivo: maritime security.

noteHi.exampleTr: नौसेना हर दिन देश की समुद्री सीमा पर गश्त करती है।
noteHi.meaning: समुद्री; समुद्र या जहाज़रानी से जुड़ा।
noteHi.usage: संज्ञा से पहले विशेषण के रूप में: maritime security।

noteJa.exampleTr: 海軍は毎日その国の海上国境を巡回している。
noteJa.usage: 名詞の前に置く：maritime security（海上安全保障）。

noteKo.exampleTr: 해군은 매일 그 나라의 해상 국경을 순찰한다.
noteKo.usage: 명사 앞에 쓰는 형용사: maritime security(해상 안보).

meaningful.ex: We need meaningful change, not small steps.

meanwhile.en: at the same time; while this happens

meet.ex: Let's meet at the station at six.

meeting.en: an event where people talk together
meeting.ex: The meeting starts at ten o'clock.

memorandum.ex: The two schools signed a memorandum of understanding.

example.en: The universities signed a memorandum to share research.
example.zh: 這些大學簽署了一份共享研究的備忘錄。

note.meaning: 備忘錄；（政府或機構間的）諒解書。
note.usage: 複數 memoranda/memorandums；memorandum of understanding (MoU) 指非正式協議。

noteEn.meaning: a written agreement or note between groups.

noteEs.exampleTr: Las universidades firmaron un memorando para compartir investigaciones.
noteEs.meaning: memorando; acuerdo escrito entre dos partes.
noteEs.usage: Memorandum of understanding (MoU) es un acuerdo no vinculante.

noteHi.exampleTr: विश्वविद्यालयों ने शोध साझा करने के लिए एक ज्ञापन पर हस्ताक्षर किए।
noteHi.meaning: ज्ञापन; दो पक्षों के बीच लिखित समझ।
noteHi.usage: memorandum of understanding (MoU) एक अनौपचारिक समझौता है।

noteJa.exampleTr: 大学同士は研究を共有する覚書に署名した。
noteJa.usage: memorandum of understanding（MoU）は正式な条約ほど拘束力のない合意。

noteKo.usage: memorandum of understanding(MoU)은 구속력이 약한 합의를 뜻한다.

met.ex: I met my old teacher in town.

micheál.en: first name of Taoiseach Micheál Martin

military.ex: He did two years of military service.

move.en: bring something to a new position
move.ex: The new law will move us closer to our goal.

mr.ex: Mr Brown is our new teacher.

narrow.ex: There is a narrow chance of success.

negotiating.ex: Both sides returned to the negotiating table.
negotiating.zh: 談判的（negotiating cluster：談判章節群）

negotiations.en: formal talks to reach an agreement
negotiations.ex: Negotiations between the two sides continue.

nevertheless.ex: It was raining; nevertheless, we went out.

nonetheless.ex: The task was hard; nonetheless, she finished it.

now.ex: I am busy now, call me later.

obligations.en: things you must do by law
obligations.ex: Citizens have legal obligations to pay tax.

on.en: at a time or day; about

open.en: to start something such as talks
open.ex: The two sides will open talks next month.

opened.ex: A new chance opened for the young team.

opening.ex: The opening of the new library was a big event.

operational.en: working and ready to be used
operational.ex: The new hospital wing will be operational next year.

example.en: The new hospital wing will be fully operational next year.
example.zh: 新的醫院側樓明年將全面啟用。

note.meaning: 運作中的；可以投入使用的。
note.usage: 常用 become/be fully operational；也可指營運上的，如 operational costs。

noteEn.meaning: working and ready to be used.

noteEs.exampleTr: El nuevo pabellón del hospital estará plenamente operativo el próximo año.

noteHi.exampleTr: अस्पताल की नई इमारत अगले साल पूरी तरह चालू होगी।
noteHi.meaning: चालू; काम करने के लिए तैयार।

noteJa.exampleTr: 新しい病棟は来年に全面稼働する。
noteJa.meaning: 稼働している；運用可能な。
noteJa.usage: become/be fully operational の形が多い。

noteKo.exampleTr: 새 병동은 내년에 전면 가동될 것이다.

opportunity.ex: This job is a great opportunity for her.
opportunity.zh: 機會（window of opportunity：機會之窗）

ought.en: should; used to say what is right
ought.ex: You ought to call your mother tonight.

out.en: used in phrases meaning away, ended or removed
out.ex: The milk ran out before breakfast.
out.zh: （片語用）出；完；盡（out of the question：不可能；year is out：年底前）

outstanding.ex: We still have three outstanding bills to pay.

own.en: belonging to that person or group
own.ex: They want to run their own business.

part.en: a piece or section of something larger
part.ex: This village is part of County Clare.

peace.ex: People in the region want lasting peace.

pilots.en: people who fly planes or drones
pilots.ex: The pilots landed the plane safely in the storm.

place.ex: The wedding will take place in June.

plan.ex: We plan to visit Galway in spring.

pledging.ex: The mayor is pledging new money for local parks.

political.ex: The two parties had a long political debate.

potential.ex: The plan has many potential benefits.
potential.ja: 潜在的な；可能性のある

predicted.en: said what will happen in the future
predicted.ex: Experts predicted a cold winter this year.

prepared.ex: We are prepared to wait a few more days.
prepared.ja: 用意ができた；〜する意思がある

presidency.en: the time a country leads a group like the EU
presidency.ex: Ireland holds the EU presidency for six months.

president.ex: The president visited three countries last month.

pressed.ex: Reporters pressed the minister for more details.

primed.ex: The team is primed for the final match.

prior.ex: Please arrive ten minutes prior to the start.

proceeding.ex: Passengers are proceeding to gate twelve.

process.en: a series of steps to do something
process.ex: The hiring process takes about a month.

progress.ex: The talks made good progress this week.

prolonged.ex: Prolonged rain caused flooding in the town.
prolonged.hi: लंबा; लंबे समय तक चलने वाला

example.en: A prolonged dry spell damaged the crops.
example.zh: 長期乾旱損害了農作物。

note.usage: 形容詞，多置於名詞前，如 prolonged conflict/period。

noteEn.usage: Used before a noun: 'a prolonged conflict'.

noteEs.exampleTr: Una sequía prolongada dañó las cosechas.
noteEs.usage: Adjetivo antes del sustantivo: prolonged conflict.

noteHi.exampleTr: लंबे सूखे ने फ़सलों को नुकसान पहुँचाया।
noteHi.meaning: लंबे समय तक चलने वाला; दीर्घ।

noteJa.exampleTr: 長引く乾燥が作物に被害を与えた。
noteJa.usage: 名詞の前に置く：prolonged conflict（長期化した紛争）。

noteKo.usage: 명사 앞에 쓴다: prolonged conflict(장기화된 분쟁).

promised.en: said you will surely do something
promised.ex: He promised to call me after the meeting.

protect.ex: Sun cream helps protect your skin.

question.en: a subject or issue; something asked

paragraphs: Ukraine's president, Volodymyr Zelenskiy, visited Dublin on Wednesday. He met the Taoiseach, Micheál Martin.
Ireland wants to use Ukrainian drones to protect its seas. Ukraine knows a lot about drones because of the war with Russia. Mr Zelenskiy said Ukraine is ready to make drones with Ireland.
Mr Zelenskiy came for a big European meeting. Ireland is hosting it this year.
He said there is a chance for peace with Russia before the end of the year. But Ukraine will not give up the Donbas region.
Some Ukrainian men in Ireland have not done military service. Mr Martin said Ireland does not plan to send them back.
EU leaders will meet in Dublin again on Friday.

paragraphs: Ireland is in talks with Ukraine about using Ukrainian drone technology to protect its seas, the Taoiseach, Micheál Martin, said on Wednesday. He spoke after meeting Ukraine's president, Volodymyr Zelenskiy, in Dublin.

Ukraine has learned a lot about drones without pilots during its war with Russia. Mr Martin said the Department of Defence is looking at a joint agreement with Ukraine on making drones and sharing the technology. Mr Zelenskiy said his country is ready to build drones together with Ireland, and he expects the deal to start working soon.
Mr Zelenskiy was in Dublin for a meeting of the European Political Community. Ireland is hosting the meeting because it holds the presidency of the Council of the EU until the end of the year.

The Ukrainian leader said there is a "window" to make progress on a peace deal with Russia before the end of 2026. Two American envoys, Steve Witkoff and Jared Kushner, were due in Dublin on Thursday to tell him about their talks. However, he said Ukraine cannot give up the Donbas region, and he wants clear answers from the United States on security guarantees.

Mr Martin said any peace deal must respect Ukraine's borders and its right to choose its own future. He also promised that Ireland would try to move Ukraine closer to joining the EU before its presidency ends.
Asked about Ukrainian men in Ireland who have not done military service, Mr Martin said the State does not plan to send them home. EU leaders will hold another meeting in Dublin on Friday.
sentZh: 愛爾蘭總理米歇爾・馬丁週三表示，愛爾蘭正與烏克蘭商談使用烏克蘭的無人機技術來保護海域。
他是在都柏林與烏克蘭總統澤倫斯基會面後發表這番談話。
在與俄羅斯的戰爭中，烏克蘭對無人駕駛的無人機累積了許多經驗。
馬丁先生說，國防部正在研究與烏克蘭簽訂一項聯合協議，內容涵蓋製造無人機和分享技術。
澤倫斯基先生說，他的國家已準備好與愛爾蘭一起打造無人機，並預期這項協議很快就會開始運作。
澤倫斯基先生是來都柏林參加歐洲政治共同體的會議。
愛爾蘭之所以主辦這場會議，是因為它在年底前擔任歐盟理事會輪值主席國。
這位烏克蘭領袖說，在2026年底前有一個推動與俄羅斯和平協議的「機會之窗」。
兩位美國特使史蒂夫・威特科夫和賈里德・庫許納預定週四抵達都柏林，向他說明會談情況。
不過，他說烏克蘭不能放棄頓巴斯地區，而且他希望美國在安全保證方面給出明確的答覆。
馬丁先生說，任何和平協議都必須尊重烏克蘭的邊界，以及烏克蘭人決定自己未來的權利。
他也承諾，愛爾蘭會在擔任主席國期滿前，努力讓烏克蘭更接近加入歐盟。
被問到在愛爾蘭尚未服兵役的烏克蘭男性時，馬丁先生說國家不打算把他們送回國。
歐盟領袖週五將在都柏林再舉行一場會議。

paragraphs: Ireland is in talks to use Ukrainian drone technology to strengthen its maritime security, Taoiseach Micheál Martin said on Wednesday after a bilateral meeting in Dublin with Ukrainian President Volodymyr Zelenskiy.

Ukraine has built up considerable expertise in unmanned drones since Russia's full-scale invasion. Mr Martin said the Department of Defence is exploring a joint memorandum with its Ukrainian counterpart covering drone manufacturing and technology. Mr Zelenskiy said Kyiv was "ready for co-production" and that he expected the arrangement to become operational.
The Ukrainian president was in the capital for a summit of the European Political Community, which Ireland is hosting as part of its presidency of the Council of the EU.

Mr Zelenskiy said there was a window of opportunity to make progress towards a peace deal with Russia by the end of the year. US envoys Steve Witkoff and Jared Kushner were expected in Dublin on Thursday to brief him before travelling on to Moscow. He insisted, however, that surrendering the Donbas was impossible and called for concrete answers from Washington on security guarantees.

Mr Martin said any settlement must recognise Ukraine's sovereignty and territorial integrity. He added that Ireland would do everything it could to open the remaining stages of Ukraine's EU membership talks before its presidency ends.

On the question of Ukrainian men in Ireland who have not completed military service, the Taoiseach said the State did not envisage returning them. EU leaders are due to gather in Dublin again on Friday for an informal meeting.

自從俄羅斯全面入侵以來，烏克蘭在無人機方面累積了可觀的專業能力。
馬丁先生說，國防部正在研議與烏克蘭國防部簽署一份涵蓋無人機製造與技術的聯合備忘錄。
澤倫斯基先生說，基輔「已準備好共同生產」，並預期這項安排將會付諸實行。
這位烏克蘭總統是來首都參加歐洲政治共同體峰會，愛爾蘭以歐盟理事會輪值主席國的身分主辦這場會議。
澤倫斯基先生說，年底前有一個推動與俄羅斯達成和平協議的機會之窗。
美國特使史蒂夫・威特科夫和賈里德・庫許納預定週四抵達都柏林向他簡報，之後再前往莫斯科。
不過，他堅稱交出頓巴斯是不可能的，並要求華府在安全保證方面給出具體答覆。
馬丁先生說，任何和解方案都必須承認烏克蘭的主權與領土完整。

談到在愛爾蘭尚未完成兵役的烏克蘭男性時，總理表示國家並未考慮將他們遣返。
歐盟領袖預定週五再次齊聚都柏林，舉行非正式會議。

paragraphs: Ireland is in discussions over harnessing Ukrainian drone technology to bolster its maritime security, the Taoiseach, Micheál Martin, disclosed on Wednesday following bilateral talks in Dublin with President Volodymyr Zelenskiy.

Battle-hardened by years of conflict, Ukraine has amassed formidable know-how in unmanned systems. According to Mr Martin, the Department of Defence is examining a joint memorandum with its Ukrainian counterpart on drone production and technology transfer, while Mr Zelenskiy declared Kyiv primed for co-production and predicted the arrangement would soon be up and running.
The Ukrainian leader had travelled to the capital for a gathering of the European Political Community, convened by Ireland under its rotating presidency of the Council of the EU.

Mr Zelenskiy contended that a narrow window had opened for headway towards a settlement with Moscow before the year is out. The American envoys Steve Witkoff and Jared Kushner were slated to brief him in Dublin on Thursday en route to the Kremlin. Nonetheless, he was adamant that ceding the Donbas was out of the question and pressed Washington for tangible commitments on security guarantees.

Mr Martin stressed that any accord must uphold Ukraine's sovereignty and territorial integrity, pledging that Ireland would leave no stone unturned in opening the outstanding chapters of Kyiv's EU accession negotiations before its term concludes.

Pressed on whether Ukrainian men who have yet to complete military service ought to be repatriated, the Taoiseach indicated that the State had no such intention. EU leaders are set to reconvene in Dublin on Friday for an informal summit.
sentZh: 愛爾蘭總理米歇爾・馬丁週三在都柏林與澤倫斯基總統舉行雙邊會談後透露，愛爾蘭正就運用烏克蘭無人機技術來強化海上安全進行討論。
歷經多年戰火淬鍊，烏克蘭在無人系統方面累積了驚人的實務知識。
據馬丁先生表示，國防部正在審視與烏克蘭國防部就無人機生產與技術移轉簽署聯合備忘錄，而澤倫斯基先生則宣稱基輔已準備好共同生產，並預言這項安排很快就能上路。
這位烏克蘭領袖是前來首都參加歐洲政治共同體的聚會，這場會議由擔任歐盟理事會輪值主席國的愛爾蘭召開。
澤倫斯基先生主張，在今年結束前，與莫斯科達成和解已出現一扇狹窄的機會之窗。
美國特使史蒂夫・威特科夫和賈里德・庫許納預定週四在前往克里姆林宮途中，於都柏林向他簡報。
儘管如此，他堅決表示割讓頓巴斯絕無可能，並敦促華府在安全保證上做出實際承諾。
馬丁先生強調，任何協議都必須維護烏克蘭的主權與領土完整，並誓言愛爾蘭會在任期結束前竭盡全力，開啟基輔入盟談判中尚未處理的章節。
被追問尚未完成兵役的烏克蘭男性是否應被遣返時，總理表示國家並無此意。
歐盟領袖將於週五在都柏林再度聚首，召開非正式峰會。

paragraphs: Ireland is engaged in negotiations concerning the potential deployment of Ukrainian drone technology to enhance its maritime security, according to the Taoiseach, Micheál Martin, who made the announcement on Wednesday following a bilateral meeting in Dublin with President Volodymyr Zelenskiy.

As a consequence of its prolonged conflict with Russia, Ukraine has developed substantial expertise in unmanned aerial systems. Mr Martin indicated that the Department of Defence is evaluating a joint memorandum with its Ukrainian counterpart on drone manufacturing and technological cooperation. Mr Zelenskiy, for his part, asserted that Kyiv was prepared to engage in co-production and anticipated that the arrangement would become operational in due course.
The Ukrainian president was attending a summit of the European Political Community, which Ireland is hosting in its capacity as holder of the presidency of the Council of the EU.

Mr Zelenskiy maintained that there exists a limited window of opportunity to achieve meaningful progress towards a peace agreement with Russia before the end of 2026. The United States envoys Steve Witkoff and Jared Kushner were scheduled to brief him in Dublin on Thursday prior to proceeding to Moscow. Nevertheless, he emphasised that relinquishing the Donbas region would be impossible and sought concrete commitments from Washington regarding security guarantees.

Mr Martin underlined that any agreement must respect Ukraine's sovereignty and territorial integrity. He further committed Ireland to facilitating the opening of the remaining negotiating clusters in Ukraine's EU accession process before its presidency concludes.

Regarding Ukrainian men residing in Ireland who have not fulfilled their military obligations, the Taoiseach stated that the State did not envisage their return. Meanwhile, attention now turns to an informal meeting of EU leaders, which is scheduled to take place in Dublin on Friday.

這位烏克蘭總統正在出席歐洲政治共同體峰會，愛爾蘭以歐盟理事會輪值主席國的身分主辦此會。
澤倫斯基先生堅稱，在2026年底前，與俄羅斯的和平協議存在一個有限的機會之窗，可望取得實質進展。

Mr Zelenskiy said Kyiv was "ready for co-production" and that he expected the arrangement to become operational.
The Ukrainian president was in the capital for a summit of the European Political Community, which Ireland is hosting as part of its presidency of the Council of the EU.

Mr Zelenskiy said there was a window of opportunity to make progress towards a peace deal with Russia by the end of the year. US envoys Steve Witkoff and Jared Kushner were expected in Dublin on Thursday to brief him before travelling on to Moscow. He insisted, however, that surrendering the Donbas was impossible and called for concrete answers from Washington on security guarantees.

Mr Martin said any settlement must recognise Ukraine's sovereignty and territorial integrity. He added that Ireland would do everything it could to open the remaining stages of Ukraine's EU membership talks before its presidency ends.

On the question of Ukrainian men in Ireland who have not completed military service, the Taoiseach said the State did not envisage returning them. EU leaders are due to gather in Dublin again on Friday for an informal meeting.
